info.title: mekaweb
info.description: The web interface for meka, served from the meka host.

200.description: Changed; every other device is signed out

409.description: There is no passkey to confirm with; confirm with the password

200.description: Signed in; the cookie is set

409.description: Passkeys do not work at this address

200.description: Signed in; the cookie is set

204.description: Signed out; the cookie is removed

206.description: The part of the file the `Range` asked for

409.description: A file of that name is there

get.summary:
Changes to a folder, as an event stream: a `change` event whenever what it holds may have
changed, at most about once a second, after which it is to be listed again. Events missed while
the stream was not open are not told, so a folder is listed again on reconnecting.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: The folder, for all it holds.

parameters.name: selection
parameters.description: The id `POST /api/files/zip/selection` gave the entries chosen, for just those.

post.summary:
Keeps entries chosen in a folder for a zip of them, which `GET /api/files/zip` then downloads
by the id given: their names would make too long an address.

204.description: The push service took the notification

410.description: The push service no longer knows this device

parameters.name: session
parameters.description: Only those of this meka session.

400.description: The folder is not one, or too many terminals are open

Confirmation.description: Confirming who you are: a passkey's answer, or the password where there is no passkey.

Confirmed.description: When the person confirmed who they are.

current.description: Whether it is the device asking.

device.description: Its browser and system, with their versions, from its user agent.

name.description: What it is called: its own name, or one from its browser.

hidden.description: Whether its name starts with a dot, or the system marks it hidden.

permissions.description: Its permissions, as `ls` writes them: `rwxr-xr-x`. Windows has none.

size.description: Its size in bytes; a folder's is what the file system says of it.

target.description: Where a symlink points, as written.

oneOf.description: What a symlink leads to, if anything.

push.description: Whether push notifications can be sent.

replace.description: Whether to replace a file of the same name.

home.description: The home folder, absolute, which `~` names; none where it is not known.

device.description: The device, named from its browser.

error.description: Why the last check failed, when it did.

reachable.description: Whether meka answered the last check.

supported.description: Whether that version is one this release works with.

verified.description: Whether that version is one this release was checked against.

parents.description: Whether to make any folders above it that are missing too.

NewPasskey.description: A new passkey: the authenticator's answer and what to call it.

NewPassword.description: A new password, and the one it replaces.

NewSelection.description: Entries chosen in a folder, to download as one zip.

cwd.description: The folder to start in; the home folder unless given.

session.description:
The meka session it belongs to, if any: it is found by it, and closes with it. A session
whose terminal is open gets that one.

replace.description: Whether it may replace a file of the same name, when it finishes.

PasskeyAnswer.description: A passkey's answer to a challenge.

credential.description: The credential the browser returned, with its bytes in URL-safe base64.

PasskeyChallenge.description: A challenge for the browser to put to an authenticator.

id.description: The id the answer comes back with.

options.description: The options for `navigator.credentials`, with their bytes in URL-safe base64.

Preferences.description: The preferences every device shares, as the interface writes them.

Problem.description: A problem, as the API answers it.

title.description: The kind of problem, in words.

type.description: `urn:mekaweb:` and what kind of problem it is.

PushState.description: Whether push notifications work, and whether this device receives them.

endpoint.description: The endpoint this device subscribed with, to tell whether the browser's is the same.

public_key.description: The key to subscribe with, uncompressed, in URL-safe base64.

name.description: The name; empty goes back to the default.

SelectionMade.description: The id a selection's zip downloads by.

SessionView.description: Who is signed in, on which device, and what they can confirm themselves with.

device_id.description: This sign-in's id, as the devices list names it.

fresh_seconds.description: How long a confirmation counts for a risky change, in seconds.

has_passkeys.description: Whether the user has a passkey.

passkeys_available.description: Whether passkeys work at this address.

verified_at.description: When the person last confirmed who they are on this device.

SignedOut.description: How many devices were signed out.

meka.description: How meka stood at the last check.

versions.description: The meka versions this release supports.

Subscription.description: A browser's push subscription, as `PushSubscription.toJSON()` writes it.

TerminalView.description: A terminal, as the list shows it.

active_at.description: When it was last typed in, attached to or left.

session.description: The meka session it belongs to, if any.

Text.description: A text file's contents, for a preview.

binary.description: Whether the file looks binary, in which case `text` is empty.

truncated.description: Whether the file is longer than what was read.

chunk_bytes.description: The most bytes a piece may hold.

Versions.description: The meka versions this release supports.

minimum.description: The oldest meka it works with.

verified.description: The versions it was checked against.
